mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS "materialId", l.id AS "locationId", l.code AS "locationCode" FROM wms_material m JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = m.default_location_id AND l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.status = 1 WHERE m.id IN #{id}

SELECT s.material_id AS "materialId", s.batch_no AS "batchNo", l.id AS "locationId", l.code AS "locationCode", s.qty AS "qty" FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.status = 1 AND l.loc_type IN ('STORAGE', 'PICK') WHERE s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.qty > 0 AND s.material_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.qty DESC, l.sort, l.code

SELECT l.id AS "locationId", l.code AS "locationCode" FROM wms_location l WHERE l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.status = 1 AND l.loc_type IN ('STORAGE', 'PICK') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id AND s.location_id = l.id AND s.qty > 0) ORDER BY l.zone, l.sort, l.code LIMIT #{limit}
